items.evidence: OS product-supply documentation states the full GB tiled national dataset contains exactly 2,858 tiles.
OS documentation states national tiled supply uses 10km-by-10km tiles.
OS documentation states the 2,858 tiles are arranged in 55 100km grid-square folders.
OS Terrain 50 grid uses regular 50m post spacing.
OS technical specification describes 200 by 200 pixels per 10km tile at 50m spacing.
OS Terrain 50 is an OpenData product with annual July refresh/full resupply.
